card.name: Linking word before a second option
card.fires_on: The word "or" or a comma right after "primary" or "before", where a paired alternative follows. Also the "ath" in nephropathy and neuropathy, and "pre" in prepositional.

modes.label: Or after a first option
modes.description: "or" or a comma after "primary" or "before", just ahead of the second term ("secondary", "during").
modes.example: OPDIVO QVANTIG can cause primary<< or>> secondary adrenal insufficiency.

modes.label: Inside -pathy words
modes.description: The "ath" piece partway through nephropathy, nephropathic or neuropathies.

card.plain: It fires on the small word that joins two options, like "primary or secondary", and on the middle of words like nephropathy.
